steps.text: 1. In the Publish step, the Contributor views the checklist of submission conditions. A3.
2. The Contributor taps "Submit for review" and confirms.
3. The system (Tour) checks the conditions: complete information, every place has a description, no place is under review or rejected by AI, at most 50 places. E1, E2, E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E1. Missing required conditions → 422 "The tour does not meet the publishing conditions yet" with the list of failed items and links to where to fix them.
E2. Places still under review / rejected by AI, or more than 50 places → the matching checklist item fails.
E3. The tour is in Restricted access mode (UC#14) or hidden by the Admin → 409.
E4. Not the author → 403; the tour does not exist → 404.

steps.text: 4. The system moves the tour to "AI review in progress" and publishes the tour.submitted event (with the tour content) over RabbitMQ. E5.

exceptions.text: E5. The event cannot be published (RabbitMQ error) → logged, the tour stays "AI review in progress"; the Contributor can submit again.

steps.text: 5. The client polls the status every 5 seconds and shows "AI review in progress". E8.

exceptions.text: E8. The client status poll fails → "Status could not be updated: …" with a "Retry" button.

steps.text: 6. Moderation creates a moderation case and runs the location rules G1–G6.
7. Moderation calls the AI service (/moderate/tour, one LLM call for the whole tour); AI returns findings and their severity. E6, E7.

exceptions.text: E6. Temporary AI error (timeout, 429, 503) after 3 attempts, or 401 → no result is published; Moderation retries every 60 seconds.
E7. AI returns 422 (invalid input) → a "needs a human" Warning for the Admin; if G1 already rejected, Reject wins.

steps.text: 8. Moderation merges the AI result and the location rules (the worst result wins), then publishes tour.ai_passed or tour.ai_rejected. A1, A2.
9. Pass: Tour moves the tour to "Pending review" and into the Admin queue.

steps: A1. Warning (0.4 ≤ severity < 0.8, or rules G2–G6): the tour moves to "AI Warning" and to the top of the Admin queue with reasons.

A2. Reject (severity ≥ 0.8, G1 invalid coordinate, or content blocked by the provider): the tour goes back to Draft with reasons; the author receives an in-app and email notification (UC#16), edits and resubmits.
A4. Edit the tour during review: the tour goes back to Draft; the AI result for the old version is ignored (revision check).
A5. Each place was already moderated separately on save (UC#10, place.submitted event, checking both text and up to 5 photos); the tour scan does not rescan the places.
A6. Moderation turned off (MODERATION_EVENTS_ENABLED=false): the "Publish" button makes the tour public at once, without AI or Admin.
